module.purpose: Provides the default user interface for viewing, selecting, creating, renaming, reordering, and resizing pages in the tldraw editor.
module.summary: This React component renders a responsive page-selection popover backed by editor page state. It supports read-only restrictions, localized labels, mobile prompt-based naming, inline renaming, page creation limits, submenu management, persisted list-height preferences, viewport-aware sizing, keyboard behavior, and pointer-based drag-and-drop reordering with automatic scrolling.
module.businessContext: Supports document/page navigation in the collaborative drawing application. Failure prevents users from switching, creating, renaming, or organizing document pages.

units.name: readSavedPageMenuListHeight

detail.name: readSavedPageMenuListHeight
postconditions: Returns a finite number at least as large as MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT when local storage contains a valid saved height.
Returns null when executed without a window, when the saved value is absent or empty, when it is not a finite number, when it is below MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT, or when local-storage access fails.
invariants: The function does not mutate the saved local-storage value.
A non-null result is always finite and at least MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT.
edgeCases: When window is undefined, returns null without attempting browser storage access.
When the configured local-storage entry is absent or its raw value is empty, returns null.
When the raw value converts to a non-finite number or a number below MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT, returns null.
When local-storage access throws, returns null rather than propagating the storage error.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns null for missing, empty, non-finite, or below-minimum stored values.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Reads the localStorage entry identified by PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT_KEY as a string, converts it with Number(raw), and returns number | null.
detail.summary: Reads the persisted page-menu list height from browser local storage and returns it only when it is a finite number meeting the configured minimum. It returns null when browser storage is unavailable, empty, invalid, or inaccessible.

units.name: getPageMenuRenderCap

detail.name: getPageMenuRenderCap
postconditions: Returns a number representing the page-menu render cap.
The cap is constrained using MAX_PAGE_MENU_RENDER_HEIGHT.
invariants: The configured maximum render-height limit is considered when calculating the cap.
detail.summary: Computes the maximum page-menu render height from the available height while applying the configured page-menu render-height limit.

units.name: getPageMenuAutoFitListHeight

detail.name: getPageMenuAutoFitListHeight
preconditions: maxMenuHeight is a number representing the maximum available page-menu height.
postconditions: Returns the greater of MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT and maxMenuHeight minus the combined create-button and resize-handle footer height.
invariants: The returned height is never less than MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT.
edgeCases: When maxMenuHeight is less than or equal to the footer height plus MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT, returns MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT.
When maxMenuHeight exceeds the footer height plus MIN_PAGE_MENU_LIST_HEIGHT, returns the remaining height after subtracting the footer height.
detail.summary: Computes the page-menu list height available beneath the menu footer while enforcing the configured minimum list height.

specTests.then: The result equals maxMenuHeight minus PAGE_MENU_CREATE_BUTTON_HEIGHT minus PAGE_MENU_RESIZE_HANDLE_HEIGHT.

units.name: DefaultPageMenu

detail.name: DefaultPageMenu
preconditions: The component is rendered within the editor, UI-event, translation, breakpoint, and readonly-mode contexts required by its hooks.
The editor provides the current page, page list, menu manager, timers, page mutation methods, and configured maximum page count.
postconditions: The rendered menu reflects the editor's current pages and current page.
Page navigation, creation, renaming, and reordering actions update editor state only when permitted by readonly and input conditions.
Opening and closing the menu maintains the component's editing, submenu, resize, and drag state consistently.
invariants: Readonly mode does not expose page mutation actions and does not initiate page dragging or renaming.
The rendered list height is the lesser of the user-selected or auto-fit height and the available-height render cap.
A dragged page's visual position is clamped to the first and last page slots.
Only one page-item submenu remains open at a time, except for the explicitly preserved submenu index.
A drag crossing the configured threshold reorders pages on pointer release and suppresses the synthetic click that follows a non-handle drag.
The current page is focused and scrolled into view when the menu opens or the current page changes.
edgeCases: When there are no pages, the auto-fit calculation and rendered output are delegated to the referenced page-menu sizing helpers; drag positioning is clamped using the available page count.
When the page count reaches the editor's maximum, the create-page control uses the maximum-pages-reached label and creation is still guarded against readonly mode.
When a pointer drag moves beyond the list bounds, the dragged row remains within the first or last slot and the list may auto-scroll near its edges.
When a pointer drag is shorter than or equal to the configured drag threshold, it remains a pending pointer interaction and does not reorder.
When a resize or rename preference cannot be read, written, or removed from localStorage, the operation continues without propagating the storage error.

When coarse-pointer mode is active on a small breakpoint, page creation and renaming use window.prompt; cancelled creation does not create a page, and an empty creation result uses the translated initial name.
When Escape is pressed during a pending or active drag, the drag is cancelled without reordering.
When the component is unmounted or the menu closes, registered resize, wheel, keyboard, and animation-loop listeners are cleaned up or stopped.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Invalid or incomplete pointer dataset values are ignored; readonly mutation attempts are ignored; cancelled prompts abort the associated operation.
